retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist, flat-color composition featuring a stylized Eye of Horus icon centered on a muted pastel background with small, widely spaced serif typography.
triggerTerms: Eye of Horus album cover style
sage green and gold flat design
excludeWhen: vibrant neon color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A large, simplified gold Eye of Horus icon dominates the center of a square sage-green field, framed by small, high-tracking serif text at the top and left edges.
coreVisualRelationships: Large central icon vs. small peripheral text
Muted sage green background vs. warm gold icon
Organic, hand-drawn icon curves vs. rigid square frame
Wide horizontal tracking in text vs. compact icon form
coreInvariants: Stylized Eye of Horus icon with a separate floating eyebrow line
Small-scale serif typography with extreme letter spacing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The Eye of Horus icon is centrally located, occupying approximately 60% of the canvas width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular pupil of the eye serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the central icon outward to the small text at the top and left margins.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space surrounds the central icon, creating a sense of calm and focus.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sage green background (low saturation, medium-high value)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm gold/yellow for the central icon
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dark charcoal or black for the small text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a soft, matte finish; the gold is slightly more saturated than the background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in different positions to maintain minimalist cohesion.
graphicDevices: Small bullet points or dashes flanking the text

candidateDirections.reason: Elegant, high-contrast humanist qualities that match the sophisticated tone.
Classic serif structure with excellent legibility at small sizes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a flat, matte sage-green square background. In the center, place a large, simplified gold Eye of Horus icon with a separate curved eyebrow line above it. The icon should have a slightly hand-drawn, organic feel with rounded terminals.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add small, uppercase serif text at the top center and the middle-left edge. Use extreme letter spacing (tracking) and flank the top text with small horizontal dashes.

verificationChecks: Is the background a flat, muted green?
Is the Eye of Horus icon centered and gold?
Is the text small, serif, and widely spaced?
Is there significant negative space around the icon?

adjustableVariables: Background hue (e.g., light blue or tan)
Text placement (e.g., bottom instead of top)
mustRedesign: Any complex textures or bevels on the icon
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the eyebrow is a separate stroke from the eye.
Check that the text is not too large or dominant.
Verify the colors are matte and low-saturation.
Confirm the Eye of Horus curl is present at the bottom left of the icon.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central iconic symbol + muted pastel background + peripheral micro-typography = Minimalist Icon Cover.
